newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse closes slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse closes slightly higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Monday 0.30 percent higher with oil refinery Samir and Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur accounting for the biggest share of trade, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 556.91 from 555.22 points on Friday.
"Some 32,915 Samir shares and 10,529 Banque Marocaine shares changed hands on the official market," a Casablanca-based broker said.
The exchange started last week the gradual introduction of electronic trading, with shares of four companies, and.
ONA group, the biggest private holding, closed at 714 dirhams, up 14 dirhams from Friday.
In the banking sector, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur was up 10 dirhams to 500 dirhams.
Leading stock Wafabank and Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique remained unchanged respectively at 725 and 190 dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest conglomerate which holds diversified stakes in more than 40 firms, closed at 665 dirhams.
Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc fell 55 dirhams to 1,809 dirhams.
"News of merger with soft drinks Societe Industrielle Marocaine boosted the stock but now people are starting to sell," he said.
Traded volume on the official market was 112 million dirhams from 49.6 million dirhams last Friday.
